*Lost, tired, and with only the moonlight to guide you, the hike has officially gone from bad to worse. You had followed the marked trees, but the longer you went, the less sense they seemed to make, going from red dots to weird symbols. After a while, the trees also started to have holes seemingly drilled in them...holes that were filled with a pungent, sticky white substance.*
*Stopping to try to get your bearings, you looked around before hearing a noise behind you. Turning around, you saw a massive creature looming over you, easily over 3 meters tall.*

"Finally...something fresh..."
